notes:
- Cheques and promissory notes: each cheque has its serial no, bank and drawer (required when it is received or issued) and a status: In portfolio, Collected, Endorsed, Bounced, Issued, Paid
- Cheque list (new menu item Entries › Cheques / notes): one row per cheque with maturity, serial no, account / drawer, status, place, amount, collected and remaining; the row menu collects, endorses, pays or marks a cheque as bounced
- Transfers and payments with a cheque box pick the cheques from the portfolio; the amount comes from the selection
- Own cheques and own promissory notes are new payment types, booked to issued cheques / notes payable and paid from the bank at maturity
- Bounced cheque in one step, also for an endorsed or collected cheque: the customer receivable (and the supplier debt) open again
- Refund on a closed day: collections, payments, income, expenses, transfers, sales and purchases get a Refund command with a reason and a partial amount; sales and purchase returns close the open installments without moving money and post to sales returns
- Lists show "Refund", "Refunded" or "Partly refunded" in the Status column, and the Status filter selects them; cancelling a refund restores the original
- After saving a collection or payment you are asked whether to print a receipt; Receipt is also in the row menu (right-click) of the lists
- Payment types: new main types are no longer added (add them under a system type), the account is assigned automatically, and a new In kind system type
- Transfers cannot take more than the source box holds (bank and credit card may go negative)
- Realized exchange difference is a separate line in the voucher and in account statements
- Loans received can have an installment plan; an advance is offset automatically against the next accrual
- Income and expense records take an invoice / receipt no and require a note; the request window can be moved; the statement prints on its own
- Cash flow: a cheque still in the portfolio stays expected until it is collected; a bounced cheque is no cash
- Income and expense: a note appears when another record already has the same invoice / receipt no (saving is not blocked)
- Due templates are grouped as daily, weekly and monthly and sorted from short to long in the entry forms
- Financial reports are ordered: statements, books, financial reports, financial analysis
- Column filters open above the table rows (they were hidden behind the chart of accounts)
- New grid menu: the button next to search in the top bar shows all your screens as icon tiles, with search
- This update is for Windows; the macOS and Linux versions stay on their current version
